prompt:

Asset type: ONE opposite-foot WALK-B animation frame for the approved javelin hunter.
Input: approved idle, authoritative identity, appearance, equipment, size and camera. Keep all this fixed. Change ONLY pose.
MANDATORY FOOT CONTACTS: SCREEN-LEFT boot is the FORWARD weight-bearing boot, with HEEL DOWN at the baseline and TOE LIFTED. SCREEN-RIGHT boot is the REAR trailing boot, with TOE DOWN and HEEL LIFTED. This is the opposite of a right-boot-forward stride. DO NOT draw a forward right boot with lifted toe. DO NOT draw a trailing left boot with lifted heel.
Pose construction: near/shield-side LEFT thigh swings forward toward the viewer and slightly screen-left, emerging clearly in front of the other leg. Its knee is forward, and its enormous boot projects into the lower-left foreground, toe tipped upward, heel touching around y960. The far/SPEAR-side RIGHT leg trails behind the torso toward screen-right, knee bent back, and its boot touches on the toe only with heel high; show a little underside/heel on this rear right boot. Keep two separate legs and open transparent gap between the boots. This is a natural right-facing three-quarter marching step with left foot leading, not a mirror of the character. Keep his face looking screen-right.
Upper body and gear: shield stays on SCREEN-LEFT forearm and is visible entirely; held javelin stays in SCREEN-RIGHT hand, its tip pointing right at waist height. Do not swap sides. Preserve EXACTLY3 spare javelins in back carrier behind left shoulder PLUS1held javelin, all4points readable. One round wooden-plank shield, gray iron riveted rim, pale brass boss and brace bands. Dark-brown young male face, curled short black hair, no beard, blue-gray scarf, ochre quilted coat with large diamonds, brown diagonal strap, brass belt buckle, brown gloves and brown boots/beige cuffs. Same huge head, short legs and chunky hands/boots.
Fixed landscape authored1585x992 canvas, same native body size as input, no fitting or resizing. Hair crown near y95, feet contact near y960, body near x770. Preserve full held spear point and butt, shield rim, back tips and both boots within clear transparent margins.
Match approved bold dark outline and broad matte cel-shaded illustrated planes exactly. True transparent alpha exterior and interior gaps. No ground, cast shadow, base, scene, FX, text, glow, painted checkerboard or watermark. Single pose only.
